limitations: The derived dataset is camera-trap-heavy and does not establish road-video safety performance.
The model has no generic deer or white-tailed-deer class; mule_deer is the strict proxy.
The driver_hazard_union view collapses mule_deer, elk, and moose for safety-oriented analysis.
Potential overlap between the public model's unknown training data and these sources has not been ruled out.
Negative images were selected from wildlife datasets and are not representative driving-video negatives.
